title: Mutation: Unit/Scaling Mismatch in Parameter

revision_history.author: system_engineer
revision_history.description: Mutation scenario: unit/scaling mismatch in parameter

patch.description: Change parameter cell_voltage_max unit from mV to V and value from 4200 to 4.2 (scaling inconsistency)

trigger: Parameter registry validation on unit consistency

expected_finding.description: parameter FB2-PRM-000001 unit is V but value 4.2 suggests mV (missing scaling)

impact_paths: All artifacts referencing cell_voltage_max will use incorrect voltage threshold
SOA voltage checks will trigger at wrong threshold
expected_remediation: Apply correct scaling (4200 mV = 4.2 V); update all dependent threshold checks
